messages:
dmitri: quick vote — do we rename conf-room B to 'The Doughnut Hole' or is that cursed? :doughnut:

mari: LOVE it. it will be a sacred space for extra-sweet retro meetings. :sparkles:

jamal: i'm in if we get a tiny neon sign and a rule: meetings longer than 30min must come with real doughnuts.

rina: can we instead make it a rotating pastry cabinet? today's theme: cronuts.

ops-bot: Heads-up: facility requests must go through facilities@redwood-inference.com for signage installs. Please do not tape neon signs to the kitchenette window. :satellite:

sticker-bot: :tada: Sticker awarded to "The Doughnut Hole" initiative! :tada:

mari: what about the lore? every team using the room must leave one sticky note with the meeting's Theme & One Liner. the first note should be the founding manifesto.

dmitri: manifesto draft: "In this hole we orbit ideas, occasionally glaze them, and always return with more sprinkles."

jamal: iconic. we need a mascot. suggestions: glazed fox, sleepy seal, or the humble donut raven.

rina: donut raven is terrifyingly good. also it implies a ritual where you loudly caw when a good idea is had.

mari: vote now with emoji: :doughnut: for name + raven mascot, :star: for name + fox, :shrug: to keep it normal.

dmitri: :doughnut:

jamal: :doughnut:

rina: :doughnut:

mari: unanimous. i will file the facilities request and ask for permission to hang a raven sticker.

ops-bot: Friendly reminder: please avoid storing food in the server room. The Doughnut Hole belongs to people only. :robot_face:

jamal: who wants to design the inaugural sticky note? i'm offering free sketches and one lukewarm coffee as payment.

dmitri: i'll do the sketch. promise it won't be cursed. maybe a raven wearing a tiny beret.

mari: please make the raven hold a tiny spreadsheet. for authenticity.

sticker-bot: Update: draft sticker submitted to #design for review. :clipboard:

rina: i officially declare this thread the founding charter of The Doughnut Hole. future meeting notes must open with "By the glaze, we convene."

mari: closing ceremonial line: "may our ideas be warm and our pastries warmish." :evergreen_tree:
